judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core WebSocket listing mechanism, but invents completely wrong names for the protocol frames and types (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage`) instead of the issue-specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, and `ConversationListMessage`. Furthermore, it directly contradicts several explicit acceptance criteria: it omits the `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config flag, fails to add `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` or `StoreCannotList`, and returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is missing instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error. In validation, it accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200`, whereas the ticket explicitly requires rejecting `limit: 0` and `limit: 201` (validating 1–200). Finally, it misses the required updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree.
